key_insight: NUMINA is a training-free identify-then-guide framework that extracts a countable latent layout from selected self- and cross-attention heads, refines it conservatively, and modulates cross-attention to steer text-to-video diffusion models to generate the correct number of objects.
problem_solved: Text-to-video diffusion models often fail to produce the exact number of objects specified by a prompt (numeral-to-instance misalignment); NUMINA addresses this by detecting layout inconsistencies and guiding regeneration without additional training.
method: Identify: select discriminative self- and cross-attention heads to derive a countable latent layout that links textual numerals to visual instances.
Refine: conservatively clean and consolidate the latent layout to avoid spurious detections or overcorrections.
Guide: modulate cross-attention signals during regeneration to encourage the model to instantiate the specified number of objects.
impact: Enables more reliable numeral grounding and controllable object counts in text-to-video generation, improving faithfulness for content creation, data augmentation, and evaluation without retraining models.
